git_lock.policy: Every implementation file must be a tracked blob identical to committed HEAD and the tracked worktree/index must be clean. This locks all result-blind critical semantics before any image residual is read.

input_locks.raw_als_missing_crs_vlr_policy: assign EPSG:25832 by the locked W1 workflow contract and disclose it; do not infer another CRS

target_queue_contract.gs4_overlap_interpretation: unresolved is not zero overlap; do not infer or relabel public subset matches

scope_limitations.implemented_driver_scope: core cohort only for this lock1 Gate A implementation
scope_limitations.extension_followup: extension mode is not yet the full 178-building round-robin driver; only a separately reviewed single queue-next follow-up may be added after the core Gate is published
scope_limitations.gs4_overlap_resolution: still unknown and never inferred as no overlap

view_selection.ranking: result-blind observability-first ranking: retain only views whose pointwise p90(1/||n_boundary^T J_xy||_2) times the locked 0.1 px localization sigma is at most 0.30 m; then select by deterministic azimuth-bin round robin ordered by predicted uncertainty ascending, p90 metres-per-pixel ascending, visible boundary count descending, normalized frame radius ascending, image name ascending
view_selection.measured_observability_contract: the selected view remains valid only if measured edge-localization p90 divided pointwise by ||n_edge^T J_xy||_2 is at most 0.30 m
view_selection.provided_views_csv_policy: disabled unless an exact path and SHA256 are added to input_locks; if enabled, every listed view remains subject to the same measured observability fail-closed contract

als_evidence.building_class_role: only class-6 points strictly inside the approved GroundSurface XY polygon may contribute; exposed cells of the largest connected class-6 XY occupancy supply all roof/eave residual XYZ and exterior directions
als_evidence.ground_class_role: projected ground context and locked class-contract audit only; class 2 does not drive the roof-edge residual and no LoD2 Z is read

boundary_extraction.method: strictly crop ALS class 6 by the approved GroundSurface XY mask; require the largest 8-connected occupied support to cover at least 90 percent of occupied cells; border-flood 4-connected exterior empty cells; from each exposed occupied cell select an actual class-6 source point furthest in the exposed direction; estimate local tangents from neighboring actual ALS boundary points; project and retain only candidates that win the target roof-cloud camera-depth z-buffer
boundary_extraction.footprint_role: target addressing and strict 2D crop/mask only; footprint perimeter coordinates and directions are forbidden in the residual and no footprint Z is read

edge_extraction.method: fixed Gaussian blur then fixed 3/10 Scharr gradient, normal-direction non-maximum suppression, locked quantile/floor hysteresis, concave-only quadratic subpixel peak interpolation, and curvature-to-noise localization sigma

confidence.method: require forward and reverse ALS-boundary/image-edge support, measured edge-localization uncertainty, a fixed translated-boundary spatial null, robust normal-equation coherence, a separated multi-hypothesis translation diagnostic, and a locked P90-minus-median guard; translation is diagnostic only and never the residual

alignment.metric_method: at the unshifted/current projection measure forward ALS-boundary to image-edge absolute signed-normal distances for orientation-compatible nearest edges; unmatched ALS boundary samples remain search-radius censored in the median and P90
alignment.metre_conversion: for every actual ALS boundary sample use its pointwise 2x2 XY projection Jacobian J_xy and r_m=abs(signed_normal_distance_px)/||n^T J_xy||_2; n is the oriented matched image-edge normal for matched samples and the projected ALS-boundary normal for censored unmatched samples; result-blind selection uses the identical pointwise ||n_boundary^T J_xy||_2 denominator; reject low-sensitivity or ill-conditioned observations
alignment.registration_diagnostic: robust Huber IRLS solution over point observations n_img_i^T J_xy_i delta_xy=signed_normal_distance_px; candidate only, never the residual metric

gate.systematic_estimator: coordinate-wise median of per-view robust normal-observation XY candidates; building-cluster bootstrap; after micro-registration use only deterministic held-out views
gate.systematic_negligible_formula: valid_views>=30 AND valid_buildings>=3 AND norm(global_coordinate_median_xy)<=0.10m AND cluster_bootstrap_CI95_upper(norm)<=0.10m
gate.systematic_threshold_rationale: 0.10 m is one third of the preregistered 0.30 m building residual limit; this conservative margin reserves at least 0.20 m for view-local scatter and prevents a shared translation from being declared negligible by result-dependent tuning
gate.building_pass_formula: raw: all selected 10..30 views valid and median(per-view direct pointwise median_residual_m)<=0.30m; after micro1: every deterministic held-out view valid and the same held-out median<=0.30m
gate.overall_pass_formula: every requested building passes AND systematic_negligible

micro_registration.method: one global shared EPSG:25832 XY translation fitted as the coordinate-wise median of direct-correspondence candidates from deterministic fit views across all requested buildings
micro_registration.maximum_shift_rationale: 1.5 m is five times the locked 0.30 m residual gate; a larger estimate is not treated as micro-registration and is blocked as a likely pose/correspondence failure
micro_registration.remeasurement: apply the same single global XY translation to raw ALS class 2/6 and rerun every selected view once; post-registration building and systematic gates use deterministic held-out views only

execution_guard.host_pid_namespace_detection: the Gate process /proc/self/status NSpid field must contain exactly one PID, proving invocation in the host PID namespace
execution_guard.cpu_gate_unknown_gpu_policy: record unknown GPU compute processes and preserve the downstream GPU-launch block; CPU-only Gate A itself requires a fresh host probe and zero known training matches
execution_guard.gpu_compute_probe_failure_policy: record the query failure and preserve downstream_gpu_stage_launch_blocked=true; do not block this CPU-only Gate A when the live host process/container probe is clean

publication.publish_method: fsync files and version directory, atomic rename of complete version directory, then atomic symlink replacement of current pointer

time_policy.note: Protocol amendment FUS-W1-AMEND-V3A-20260725 makes 06:30 a status snapshot only; Gate A has no time-based cancellation path.
